description: This file defines the RemoteImageNode class for handling remote image nodes within a Lexical editor. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, DOM integration, and rendering via React components.

classes.name: RemoteImageNode
classes.description: A custom Lexical Node class representing a remote image, with capabilities for importing/exporting JSON, importing from DOM, DOM export, and rendering.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string type identifier for the node.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a RemoteImageNode with the given src and optional alt text.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of a RemoteImageNode instance.

methods.name: importJSON
methods.description: Creates a RemoteImageNode from a serialized JSON object.

methods.name: exportJSON
methods.description: Serializes the node into a JSON object.

methods.name: importDOM
methods.description: Defines how to convert DOM elements into this node type during parsing.

methods.name: exportDOM
methods.description: Exports the node to a DOM element for rendering.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Returns a JSX element rendering the node, utilizing the RemoteImageComponent React component.
